text: Only Manchega ewes' milk may be used. The curd is reheated to at most 40 °C, pressed for up to 12 hours and ripened from one month to two years, giving a firm pressed paste. The moulds stamp the traditional braided-grass (pleita) pattern on the sides and a flower (flor) on the faces.

steps.note: The cheese, 0.4–4 kg, is pressed in moulds up to 12 cm tall and 22 cm wide, which stamp a braided-grass pattern on its sides and a flower on its faces.
The cheese is salted in brine, dry, or both.
The cheese is ripened at least 30 days if it weighs up to 1.5 kg, otherwise 60 days, and at most 2 years.
